newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain CPI seen up at 1.6 pct y/y in June,July-bank.
newsitem.headline: Spain CPI seen up at 1.6 pct y/y in June,July-bank.

text.p: Spanish consumer inflation will pick up slightly to 1.6 percent year-on-year in June, and that is likely to be maintained in July, a forecast of Caixa de Catalunya said on Monday.

The Catalonian savings bank added that the core inflation rate, or the consumer price index without volatile energy and food components, is expected to remain unchanged in June and in July at May's of 1.9 percent.
Overall CPI rose in May to 1.5 percent year on year, and June data are scheduled on July 11.
